acceptance_criteria.description: Users must be unable to access any page without first logging in with valid credentials. Attempting to access a protected page without authentication should redirect or block the user.
kane_steps: Navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html without logging in
Observe whether the page is accessible or the user is redirected
Confirm the user is not shown the inventory page and is instead redirected to the login page
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Protected pages blocked without valid login

acceptance_criteria.description: After entering valid credentials (standard_user / secret_sauce) and submitting the login form, the user is redirected to the product inventory page.
kane_steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'
Click the login button
Confirm the user is redirected to the inventory page (URL contains /inventory.html)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Successful login redirects to inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page must display product tiles, each containing the product name, an image, and a price.
kane_steps: Log in with valid credentials and navigate to the inventory page
Inspect each product tile on the page
Confirm every tile displays a product name, an image, and a price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Inventory tiles show name, image, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product name on the inventory page opens the product detail page for that product.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the name of any product
Confirm the product detail page opens and displays the correct product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product name opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product image on the inventory page opens the product detail page for that product.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the image of any product
Confirm the product detail page opens and displays the correct product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product image opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: The product detail page must display the product name, description, price, and an 'Add to cart' button.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on any product to open its detail page
Confirm the detail page shows the product name, a description, the price, and an 'Add to cart' button
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Product detail page shows all required fields

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can add a product to the cart from the inventory page by clicking the 'Add to cart' button on a product tile.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the 'Add to cart' button on any product tile
Confirm the product is added to the cart (cart badge count increases)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart works from inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking 'Add to cart' on a product tile, the button label for that product changes to 'Remove'.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Note the button label reads 'Add to cart' for a product
Click the 'Add to cart' button
Confirm the button label changes to 'Remove'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Button changes to Remove after adding

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart badge in the top navigation updates to reflect the total number of items currently in the cart.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Observe the cart badge (should show 0 or be absent)
Click 'Add to cart' on one product
Confirm the cart badge now displays '1', then add another product and confirm it shows '2'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart badge count updates on item add

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can remove a product from the cart directly from the inventory page by clicking the 'Remove' button.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add a product to the cart
Locate the 'Remove' button for the added product
Click the 'Remove' button
Confirm the cart badge count decreases and the product is no longer in the cart
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove button removes item from cart

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking the 'Remove' button on a product tile, the button label changes back to 'Add to cart'.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add a product to the cart
Confirm the button label reads 'Remove'
Click the 'Remove' button
Confirm the button label changes back to 'Add to cart'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Button reverts to Add to cart after removal

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can navigate to the cart page by going to /cart.html and the page loads successfully.
kane_steps: Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html
Confirm the cart page loads without errors

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart page lists all items that have been added to the cart, displaying each item's name, quantity, and price.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add one or more products to the cart
Navigate to the cart page at /cart.html
Confirm each added item is listed with its name, quantity, and price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart page lists items with name, quantity, price

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page provides a sort dropdown in the top-right area with options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), and Price (high to low).
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate and click the sort dropdown in the top-right area
Confirm the dropdown contains exactly the four options: 'Name (A to Z)', 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', 'Price (high to low)'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown has all four required options

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Price (low to high)' from the sort dropdown displays the cheapest product (Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99) as the first item.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Price (low to high)'
Confirm the first product tile displayed is 'Sauce Labs Onesie' priced at $7.99
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price low-to-high sort shows cheapest item first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Name (A to Z)' from the sort dropdown displays 'Sauce Labs Backpack' as the first item in the list.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Name (A to Z)'
Confirm the first product tile displayed is 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name A-to-Z sort shows Backpack first
